privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey must be titled 'Q4 2024 Post-Purchase Customer Satisfaction'. The four custom attributes must be exactly: 'Customer Segment', 'Store Region', 'Loyalty Tier', and 'Annual Spend Bracket'. There should be 8 participants. Example mapping: Sarah Mitchell (s.mitchell@globalretail.com) should have attributes: Premium, Northeast, Gold, High. James Rodriguez (j.rodriguez@globalretail.com) should have: Standard, Southeast, Silver, Medium.
